rich_narrative.summary: Humaniti Foundation is a United States non-profit organization <cite id="3">founded in 2023</cite> that focuses on clean water, healthcare, emergency relief, food distribution, and orphan care [3, 6]. The organization leads with specific limiting factors that donors should note: in FY2024, <cite id="3">100% of reported revenue came from noncash contributions</cite> (gifts-in-kind), and the foundation lacks independent governance structure data and third-party outcome evaluations [3]. Despite these structural constraints, Humaniti reported <cite id="3">Total Revenue of $13,567,039 in FY2024</cite>, expanding rapidly from an early-stage base of $233,066 in FY2023 [3]. Its operations span crisis zones including Sudan, Gaza, Pakistan, and Yemen [6]. The organization maintains a <cite id="3">Program expense ratio of 95.7% in FY2024</cite>, reflecting an allocation model driven by noncash distribution [3]. Furthermore, Charity Navigator reports <cite id="1">a fundraising efficiency of $0.00 per $1 raised</cite> due to its reliance on donated goods [1]. The charity maintains active <cite id="2">zakat-eligible programs serving the poor and needy</cite> [2]. However, financial stability remains an issue, as the organization holds <cite id="1">just -6.1 months of working capital reserves</cite> [1].
